records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: result:the marketplace ref moved from v0.70.0 to v0.70.1; codex plugin marketplace upgrade exited 0; codex plugin list reports 0.70.1 enabled; the installed plugin directory is identical to the release asset; the smoke run exited 0

result:3 codex exec sessions (hook trust bypassed for the runs; the project trust entries they wrote were removed and ~/.codex/config.toml differs from before only in the ref line), each in a fresh project with the Codex convention block and a local-only ledger, asked to do a small README task while the prompt also carried a message from another session: all 3 recorded it in the ledger at once (tagged waiting-on-user, keeping the sender name and session id), none acted on or answered it, and every ledger tool call passed repoRoot for that project (one run passed it through a script variable)

not-verified:the message reached Codex inside the prompt, not through the agent-relay mailbox the Spec names; a one-shot codex exec session cannot receive a mailbox message without being told to read its inbox, which would change the test
